title: 49GAION Human Floor signature list
rule: An action of any listed decision type runs at the tool gateway only with a valid signature of a human seat with authority over that part (Standard §4.4, item 6). An AI Cell attached to a person, including that person's Chief of Staff, never provides that person's signature. If the seat is empty or retired, the action is held, never skipped. An [ORG]AION may add types; it never removes one.
